name: Qing Xiang
source:
“I am trying to save the world. Do you want to help me?”

For Tan Yan, there is little hope his life will change. Stuck as a convenience store clerk, he follows the same work schedule every day, unappreciated by his boss and peers.

The dreams he once had led him to this city against his parents' wishes. With no friends or lovers, he now finds himself losing all hope and struggles to survive every day. It's like his whole life is trapped inside a snowdome, unable to escape.

But on a chance encounter, he meets a girl who innocently reaches out to him, asking him to help her save the world. Would this prove to be the turning point in his life?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1131740/Snowdome/?l=english]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“我正在努力拯救世界。你想帮助我吗？”

对于谭延来说，他的生活几乎没有改变的希望。作为一名便利店店员，他每天都遵循相同的工作时间表，不受老板和同事的赏识。

曾经的梦想，违背父母的意愿，来到了这座城市。没有朋友也没有爱人，他现在发现自己失去了所有希望，每天都在为生存而挣扎。他的一生就像被困在一个雪穹里，无法逃脱。

但一次偶然的机会，他遇到了一个天真地向他伸出援手的女孩，请求他帮助她拯救世界。这会成为他人生的转折点吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1131740/Snowdome/?l=english]Steam[/url]]
